title: Preserve explicit native compiler flags in build dependencies
reason: The pinned native dependencies are installed before extensions can run, and Apple Clang from Xcode 26 needs a C++20/fmt compatibility definition supplied by Cantrip's build driver. Upstream currently erases CXXFLAGS specifically for build dependencies.
removal: Remove after the pinned upstream native dependencies compile with the current Apple Clang without compatibility flags, or upstream preserves explicit CXXFLAGS itself.
